items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Because he was supposed to play with him for a while. Well, he played with him for a while.

ctx.x: Do you remember old man Willie Umphrey? That is not our young man.
I know from Jim Umphrey on down. He was called Willie Umphrey.
Did Willie Umphrey play at the Eagle band whenever you heard him or not?
